description: This Java interface defines a contract for handling 'unvoid' operations on objects that implement the Voidable interface within the OpenMRS framework. It specifies a method to restore such objects to a 'non-voided' state and is intended to be implemented by classes that handle unvoiding actions, often utilizing aspect-oriented programming (AOP) to trigger these handlers during service method executions.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles unvoiding an object by setting its voided status and related properties to null; invoked around unvoid* service methods to perform the unvoiding process.
